name: ayu-dark-emc
description: A warm, low-glare Ayu dark theme with an OKLCH-balanced palette, ported from the ayu-dark-emc Emacs theme.

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run check && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --baseContentUrl https://github.com/jerryemc/ayu-dark-emc/blob/HEAD/vscode --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/jerryemc/ayu-dark-emc/raw/HEAD/vscode
scripts.publish: npm run build && npm run check && npx --yes @vscode/vsce publish --baseContentUrl https://github.com/jerryemc/ayu-dark-emc/blob/HEAD/vscode --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/jerryemc/ayu-dark-emc/raw/HEAD/vscode
